versions.changelog: 3.0.4: 修正表格渲染缺陷，补回六表末行新增列取值
3.0.3: 新增数据最小化声明(不上传形象声音样本)与执行边界；收窄触发词(SQP-1 unexpected)；生态动态更新至2026-10-09；各模块增补示例与表格维度
内容增强：形象模板由3类扩充至4类（新增适老无障碍型）并补不适用场景；新增形象要素规范表与形象声音授权六字段要求；人设模块新增语速与情绪参数、人设要素清单、禁止表述清单；新增场景匹配表、内容合规清单、运营指标表与风险异常处置表；新增授权与数据纪律表及五组指令示例；监管动态扩充至7项并更新至 2026-09-13

Financial Digital Avatar Creator 3.0.1

- Updated description to emphasize AI-driven avatar design, voice cloning, personality, and brand integration for fintech and digital banking.
- Added recent financial regulatory updates (as of 2026-05-25) affecting digital avatar compliance and governance.
- Outlined key industry pain points and how this skill addresses them.
- Listed trigger keywords in both English and Chinese for improved discoverability.
- Detailed avatar design templates, voice, and personality customization options for financial use cases.
- Added a disclaimer clarifying educational purpose.
